newsitem.title: USA: Gabelli cuts Bay Meadows stake to 3.72 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gabelli cuts Bay Meadows stake to 3.72 pct.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Friday it reduced its stake in Bay Meadows Operating Co to 3.72 percent or 214,400 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold 44,500 shares of Bay Meadows on Nov 25 and 26 at $34.5238 to $34.75 a share.
Shares of Bay Meadows trade under a pairing agreement with California Jockey Club as a single unit.
Bay Meadows operates the Bay Meadows horse racing track in San Francisco while California Jockey is a real estate investment trust that owns the race track land and other pieces of land nearby.
